finalSourceFreeze.scope: Isolated staging source. The actual project checkout is read-only and unchanged by this proof.

ui.conditions: Actual local controller in an event-capable DOM fixture. Most new lifecycle/admission probes use an injected branded stub to isolate GUI behavior. The explicit integration case uses the actual native/WASM parser, privately branded distribution helper and prepare guard. Layout/GPU evidence comes from the real browser.

browser.executionOwner: Root exclusively ran the actual HTTP/Chrome proof under approved controlled-test permission. The UI agent did not start network/browser processes and only read results and viewed screenshots.

legacyBrowserStatus: No legacy browser rerun is claimed in this summary. Subsequent actual controlled runs, if completed, will be recorded in a separate web-legacy-addendum.json without replacing this report.

independentUiQuality.scope: Independent real controller/native private-proposal checks with all six siblings absent; overlaps other verification rather than additive unique coverage.

retainedAttempts.scope: Initial 37 injected new GUI cases plus three translation-catalogue cases. The actual native integration and old alignment regressions are explicitly absent from this early run; later confirmed78 includes them.

limits: All verification is in the isolated /tmp source project and temporary author workspaces; the actual repository is not applied by this report. Temporary source-memory Apply and ordinary Save are genuine and separately tested.

Distribution uses 3–128 explicitly selected UUIDs along one authored axis. Numeric sort retains declaration order for equal values including signed zero. The renderer, bounds, rotated faces and screen positions are not involved.

The GUI does not calculate authored distribution. It displays the native orderedInstanceIds and source-ordered complete before/after objects; original endpoint coordinates remain and insufficient binary64 spacing is rejected atomically.
Global selection survives filtering; no objects are implicitly selected. Raw axis/query/checkbox/UUID intent, stale source/session, obsolete DOM row and late responses cannot replay approval.

Original privately branded proposals pass unchanged to memory application; the controller imports no sibling author editor, renderer, World, HTTP, backend or Save capability. Ordinary Save and conflict authority remain with the main source editor.
UI/native/core/prepared/browser and full-application scopes overlap and are not summed into unique coverage. Full-application completion is recorded by the root separately.
